body.p: Amendment under 37 C.F.R. § 1.312
The foregoing amendments and these remarks are in response to the Notice of Allowance

mailed on February 26, 2025. Pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 1.312 and MPEP § 716.14, this amendment is being filed before the payment of the issue fee. No fees are believed due in connection with this paper. Nonetheless, the Commissioner is authorized to charge any fees
which may be required in connection with this response or credit any overpayments to Deposit Account Number 50-6747.

The specification and claims are amended based on Applicant's further review. As set forth in the Amendments to the Specification section above, several paragraphs of the specification are amended. These amendments are made for consistency in terminology usage
and/or to correct typographical errors. One new paragraph is added to refer to FIG. 6. As set forth in the Listing of Claims above, claim 17 is amended to correct a typographical error.
It is respectfully submitted that the amendments are fully supported by the original
application. No new matter is believed to be entered by these amendments. Accordingly, it is
respectfully submitted that no additional search or examination would be required.
In light of the foregoing, Applicants respectfully request entry of the foregoing

amendments without withdrawing the application from issue. The Examiner is respectfully requested to contact the undersigned at the indicated telephone number if there are any issues with this submission.
Respectfully submitted,
